page.layout: One printed title page, rotated on the scan. Centred text block with a small top line, a large central word, an italic subtitle, a small line and a short word near the foot. No margins with text. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out.
page.notes: The scan is rotated 90 degrees and very faint. Much of the text shows through from the reverse side and cannot be separated from the printed lines. Only the large central word is reasonably clear, and even it is doubtful. The lines marked illegible are guesses at position and size only. The right-hand strip with German words (for example "VERI", "Schrift", "Liebe", "Erde") is the adjacent page's edge and is not transcribed.
